## Problem

What problem or limitation are you trying to solve? Describe the affected workflow,
users, and impact rather than only naming a feature.

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you want, including inputs, outputs, user experience, and
compatibility expectations where relevant.

## Alternatives

What existing features, workarounds, or alternative designs have you considered?
Explain why they are insufficient.

## Additional context

Add examples, diagrams, screenshots, references, or implementation considerations.
Only include content you have permission to share.

## Scope and compatibility

- Does this change an existing API or stored project format?
- Does it add or change an output target, export format, or rebuild mode?
- Does it require a new runtime dependency or external service?
- Could it be delivered incrementally?

## Pre-submission checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and roadmap documents.
- [ ] I described the underlying problem and not only my preferred implementation.
- [ ] I considered backward compatibility and security implications.
- [ ] I am willing to help test or implement the proposal, if applicable.
